creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From tooling-feedback card a_326iWSzf0, its first fix. `muster tab new --run '<cmd>'` returns in 0.06 s, but `<cmd>` starts 0.75-0.96 s later on a devenv: 0.54 s of that is the person's interactive login bash, which the pane runs before `--run`.

A way to start the program directly, such as `--exec <argv>`, would remove most of the delay for a pane that only shows something. Open: what the pane does when the program exits (a `--run` pane drops back to its shell), what environment it gets without the profile, and how it sits with Fencil `pane-command-job-control`.

Not approved to build: it adds a flag to the CLI and a field to the daemon's protocol, which fails the third approval test. Recommendation: wait until canvas panes land (a_2n4ry4yY0), since they cover the card's own case, an image shown at once, and see whether anything still needs this.
title: pane new: start a pane's program without the login shell
